48 张水墨图例48 ink-wash figures

48 张会动,滚到哪张就画哪张,一支笔一笔一笔画;分 15 类。每张都是几十行代码:换字、换颜色、换数据比照着画快。手机上图框可以左右拖,图里的字不会缩到看不清。图例是例子,不是模板。48 are animated and paint themselves when you scroll to them, one stroke at a time; 15 categories. Each is a few dozen lines of code. On a phone drag a figure sideways; labels never shrink below readable. Figures are examples, not templates.

越用越懂你Learns your taste

这一类图是口味学习自己画的:构建时在模拟读者上真跑 design-taste,曲线和数字都是算出来的。Drawn by the taste engine itself: built by running design-taste on simulated readers, every number is computed.

笔墨基础Brush and ink

五样里最难做的是笔和墨:墨分五色、提按、飞白、晕开、一方印、四种设色。The hardest of the five is brush and ink: five tones, pressure, dry brush, bleed, a seal, four ways of colouring.

物件Things

常画的东西都有现成的一笔一笔画法:梅兰竹菊松、山石水云、舟亭桥、人物与鹤鱼马。Things painted often, stroke by stroke: plum, orchid, bamboo, chrysanthemum, pine; rock, water, cloud; boat, pavilion, bridge; people, crane, fish, horse.

诗词Poems

诗竖排题在留白处,一字一字写出来,画跟着诗走。The poem is written vertically into the empty paper, one character at a time, and the picture follows it.

四季Four seasons

按季节换设色:春花青嫩绿胭脂,夏浓墨重绿,秋赭石朱膘,冬留白当雪。Colouring follows the season: spring indigo, young green and rouge; summer heavy ink and green; autumn ochre and vermilion; winter leaves the paper as snow.

山水Landscape

远淡近浓,水和天不画,雾在山间慢慢移。Far is pale, near is dark; water and sky are left unpainted; mist drifts slowly between the hills.

武侠 · 太极Wuxia · taiji

泼墨、焦墨高对比,刀光剑气用飞白,一招一式按笔顺画出。Splashed ink and burnt-ink contrast; a blade's flash is dry brush; each move appears in stroke order.

电影 · 动漫 · 短剧Film · anime · short drama

分镜、宽银幕推镜、角色和竖屏封面:字由代码写,不交给出图模型。Storyboards, a widescreen push-in, a character and a vertical cover: words are code, never left to an image model.

壁纸Wallpapers

大留白,图标和时间所在的地方空着。Wide empty paper; the places for icons and the clock stay empty.

技术框图 · 流程Diagrams · flows

读懂优先:线必须连对,一色一事;远淡近浓分层次,数据像水沿渠流。Reading first: every line connects correctly, one colour per meaning; depth by ink tone, data flowing like water in a channel.

代码大白话Code in plain words

左边代码、右边画,同一个时钟走:高亮到哪一行,画就动到哪一步。Code on one side, picture on the other, on one clock: the lit line and the picture move together.

数学 · 算法Maths · algorithms

图里的数都由同一段代码算出来,说明文字引用的也是它。Every number in the picture is computed by the same code the caption quotes.

文档 · 网页 · 界面Docs · web · UI

水墨在界面里只做点缀:书法标题、墨痕分隔线、印章当状态,正文照样清楚好读。In an interface ink is an accent: brush titles, ink rules, a seal as a status; body text stays plain and readable.

发布会Launch

一屏一句话,泼墨揭幕,巨大的书法字。One sentence per screen, an ink-splash reveal, huge brush letters.

数据图Charts

墨条当柱,山脊线当折线,数由代码算。Ink bars for columns, a ridge line for a line chart, numbers computed.
